import re
lines = ['X-DSPAM-Confidence: 0.8475', 'Subject: Update now', 'X-DSPAM-Confidence: 0.6178']
total = 0.0
count = 0
for line in lines:
    x = re.findall(r'^X\S*: ([0-9.]+)', line)
    if len(x) > 0:
        print(x[0])
        total = total + float(x[0])
        count = count + 1
print(count)
print('%.4f' % total)

name.en: Only the two confidence lines entered the count

tests.code: assert count == 2, 'expected: count 2 | actual: %r' % (count,)
assert abs(total - 1.4653) < 0.0001, 'expected: total 1.4653 | actual: %r' % (total,)

tests.code: assert 'Subject' not in __learner_output__ and '0.6178' in __learner_output__ and '0.8475' in __learner_output__, ('expected: 0.8475 and 0.6178 without Subject | actual: %r' % __learner_output__)

import re
log = [
    'From stephen.marquard@uct.ac.za Sat Jan  5 09:14:16 2008',
    'X-DSPAM-Confidence: 0.8475',
    'Author: stephen.marquard@uct.ac.za',
    'X-DSPAM-Probability: 0.0000',
    'From cwen@iupui.edu Thu Jan  3 16:23:48 2008',
    'X-DSPAM-Confidence: 0.6178',
    'X-DSPAM-Probability: 0.0000',
    'X-DSPAM-Confidence: 0.6961',
    'Subject: Past deadline',
    'X-DSPAM-Confidence: 0.8386',
    'From zqian@umich.edu Fri Jan  4 18:10:48 2008',
]
total = 0.0
count = 0
for line in log:
    x = re.findall(r'^X-DSPAM-Confidence: ([0-9.]+)', line)
    if len(x) > 0:
        total = total + float(x[0])
        count = count + 1
print('confidence count: %d' % count)
print('average: %.4f' % (total / count))

tests.code: assert 'confidence count: 4' in __learner_output__, ('expected: confidence count: 4 | actual: %r' % __learner_output__)
assert 'average: 0.7500' in __learner_output__, ('expected: average: 0.7500 | actual: %r' % __learner_output__)
assert count == 4 and abs(total - 3.0) < 0.000001, ('expected: count 4, total 3.0 | actual: count %r total %r' % (count, total))
